words.enDefinition: a business that transports belongings to a new home

examples.en: The moving company called to confirm when it could collect our boxes.
examples.zh: 「搬家公司」打来电话，确认什么时候来取我们的箱子。

examples.en: We booked a moving company because neither of us could drive a van.
examples.zh: 我们俩都不会开厢式货车，所以预约了「搬家公司」。

words.enDefinition: a van used to carry belongings to another home

examples.en: The removal van arrived just as I was taking my last box downstairs.
examples.zh: 我正把最后一箱东西搬下楼时，「搬家货车」到了。

examples.en: Make sure there's enough space outside for the removal van on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 周六早上要确保外面有足够空间停「搬家货车」。

words.enDefinition: a person hired with a van to move a small load

examples.en: We hired a man with a van to take our boxes across town.
examples.zh: 我们雇了个「个人搬运司机」，把装箱的东西运到城另一头。

examples.en: A man with a van was cheaper than hiring a whole removal crew.
examples.zh: 请一个「个人搬运司机」比雇整支搬家队便宜。

collocations: hire a man with a van
book a man with a van

words.enDefinition: an estimate of what a moving service will charge

examples.en: I requested a moving quote after counting how many boxes we would have.
examples.zh: 数了大概会装几箱之后，我询了「搬家报价」。

examples.en: The moving quote included the cost of carrying everything up three flights of stairs.
examples.zh: 「搬家报价」包含把所有东西搬上三段楼梯的费用。

words.enDefinition: a list of items that are being transported during a move

examples.en: We used the moving inventory to check that every box had been delivered.
examples.zh: 我们照着「搬家物品清单」核对，确认每箱东西都送到了。

examples.en: The bookshelf was missing from the moving inventory, so I added it myself.
examples.zh: 「搬家物品清单」上漏了书架，我就自己加上了。

words.enDefinition: costs incurred when relocating to another home

examples.en: I set some money aside for moving expenses before signing the summer lease.
examples.zh: 签暑期租约前，我留了一笔钱付「搬家开销」。

examples.en: Our moving expenses were lower because a friend helped carry the heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 有朋友帮忙搬重箱子，我们的「搬家开销」就少了。

words.enDefinition: a move involving a limited number of belongings

examples.en: We only had a few boxes, so the company booked us for a small move.
examples.zh: 我们一共才几箱东西，所以搬家公司给我们约的是「小件搬家」。

examples.en: Ask if they charge a minimum fee even for a small move across town.
examples.zh: 问问即使是同城「小件搬家」，他们是否也有最低收费。

words.enDefinition: a move between homes within the same area

examples.en: We booked a local move because our two flats were in the same neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 两套公寓在同一片街区，我们约的是「本地搬家」。

examples.en: The company had a weekday slot for a local move at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期末那家公司有个工作日的「本地搬家」时段。

words.enDefinition: a move that covers a considerable distance between homes

examples.en: I sold the desk before my long-distance move rather than paying to transport it.
examples.zh: 「长途搬家」之前我卖掉了书桌，省得花钱运过去。

examples.en: A long-distance move can take longer if the company combines several customers' loads.
examples.zh: 如果搬家公司把几家的物品合车运输，「长途搬家」可能更费时间。

words.enDefinition: moving services designed for students and their belongings

examples.en: The union recommended a company that does student removals during the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 学生会推荐了一家暑假提供「学生搬家服务」的公司。

examples.en: I found cheaper student removals by booking before everyone finished their final exams.
examples.zh: 我赶在大家期末考完前下单，订到了更便宜的「学生搬家服务」。

words.enDefinition: the workers who lift and transport belongings during a move

examples.en: The moving crew carried the sofa down without touching the freshly painted wall.
examples.zh: 「搬家工人组」把沙发搬下楼，没蹭到刚刷好的墙。

examples.en: I showed the moving crew which boxes needed to stay in the hallway.
examples.zh: 我告诉「搬家工人组」哪些箱子要留在走廊里。

words.enDefinition: a paid service that boxes and protects items before transport

examples.en: We skipped the packing service and spent Friday evening boxing everything up ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们没选「打包服务」，周五晚上自己装好了所有东西。

examples.en: I asked whether the packing service included materials for wrapping glasses and plates.
examples.zh: 我问了「打包服务」是否包含包玻璃杯和盘子的材料。

words.enDefinition: the rental of a van for a short period

examples.en: Van hire cost less when we moved on a weekday instead of Saturday.
examples.zh: 工作日「租厢式货车」搬家，比周六便宜。

examples.en: I checked whether the van hire came with unlimited mileage for our trip.
examples.zh: 我核对了这回「租厢式货车」是否不限里程。

words.enDefinition: a rental that allows pickup and return in different places

examples.en: A one-way van rental meant we could leave the vehicle in the next city.
examples.zh: 办了「异地还车的货车租用」，我们就能把车还在另一个城市。

examples.en: I compared the one-way van rental with driving back after unloading all my things.
examples.zh: 我比较了「异地还车的货车租用」和卸完东西再开回去还车的成本。

words.enDefinition: a designated space where vehicles load and unload cargo

examples.en: The caretaker told us to use the loading bay instead of blocking the entrance.
examples.zh: 管理员让我们用「装卸区」，别堵在入口。

examples.en: Our building only lets residents reserve the loading bay for two hours at a time.
examples.zh: 我们这栋楼的住户一次只能预约「装卸区」两小时。

words.enDefinition: a lift intended for deliveries, equipment or building staff

examples.en: The building manager asked our movers to use the service elevator at the back.
examples.zh: 楼管请搬家工人走后面的「货运电梯」。

examples.en: We had to reserve the service elevator before bringing the wardrobe into the building.
examples.zh: 把衣柜搬进楼里之前，我们得先预约「货运电梯」。

words.enDefinition: to book exclusive or scheduled lift access for a move

examples.en: Make sure to reserve the elevator if we move the sofa upstairs tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果明天要把沙发搬上楼，记得先「预约电梯」。

examples.en: I called reception to reserve the elevator for an hour on moving day.
examples.zh: 我打给前台，在搬家当天「预约了一小时电梯」。

collocations: reserve the elevator for an hour

words.enDefinition: a temporary closure of a parking space to ordinary users

examples.en: We asked about a parking suspension so the van could stop outside our flat.
examples.zh: 我们咨询了「暂停路边停车」的办法，好给搬家货车留个位置。

examples.en: The sign warned drivers about the parking suspension during our move on Monday.
examples.zh: 标牌提醒司机，我们周一搬家时这里将「暂停路边停车」。

words.enDefinition: a range of times during which a delivery may arrive

examples.en: I picked an afternoon delivery window because I had a morning tutorial on campus.
examples.zh: 早上要到学校上辅导课，我就选了下午的「送达时间段」。

examples.en: We planned lunch around the delivery window for the boxes from our old flat.
examples.zh: 我们根据旧公寓那批箱子的「送达时间段」安排午饭。

words.enDefinition: to lift and take something to a higher floor

examples.en: We asked what the movers could carry upstairs without using a furniture lift.
examples.zh: 我们问了搬家工人，不用家具升降设备的话，什么东西能「搬上楼」。

examples.en: This box is too heavy to carry upstairs on your own after class.
examples.zh: 这个箱子太重，你下课后一个人没法「搬上楼」。

words.enDefinition: a time reserved for a resident to move belongings in

examples.en: I chose the first move-in slot so my parents could drive home before dark.
examples.zh: 我选了最早的「搬入时段」，这样爸妈就能天黑前开车回家。

examples.en: Reception asked everyone to stick to their move-in slot because the lifts were busy.
examples.zh: 电梯比较忙，前台请大家按自己预约的「搬入时段」到场。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled meeting for leaving a property and handing it back

examples.en: I booked a move-out appointment for the morning after my final exam ended.
examples.zh: 我把「搬离交接预约」定在最后一门考试结束后的次日上午。

examples.en: Bring all sets of keys to your move-out appointment at the housing office.
examples.zh: 去住宿办公室办理「搬离交接预约」时，把所有钥匙都带上。

words.enDefinition: a secure box for returning keys without meeting someone

examples.en: The office was closed, so I left the keys in the key drop box.
examples.zh: 办公室关门了，我就把钥匙投进「钥匙投递箱」。

examples.en: Reception told us the key drop box was next to the front entrance.
examples.zh: 前台告诉我们，「钥匙投递箱」就在正门旁边。

collocations: leave keys in the key drop box

words.enDefinition: to give a property's keys back when leaving

examples.en: I need to return the keys after we take our last bags downstairs.
examples.zh: 我们把最后几袋东西搬下楼后，我就要「交还钥匙」。

examples.en: The landlord asked us to return the keys at the office before noon.
examples.zh: 房东请我们中午前到办公室「交还钥匙」。

words.enDefinition: an extra group of keys for the same property

examples.en: My roommate kept a spare set of keys while I was abroad for summer.
examples.zh: 我暑假出国时，室友留了一套「备用钥匙」。

examples.en: The landlord asked whether a spare set of keys was still with reception.
examples.zh: 房东问前台是否还留着一套「备用钥匙」。

collocations: keep a spare set of keys
make a spare set of keys
return a spare set of keys

words.enDefinition: a list used to check tasks when transferring a property

examples.en: We went through the handover checklist before giving the flat back to the owner.
examples.zh: 我们把「交接清单」过了一遍，才把公寓交还房东。

examples.en: The handover checklist helped us remember to return both sets of keys to reception.
examples.zh: 靠这份「交接清单」提醒，我们记得把两套钥匙都还给前台。

words.enDefinition: a postal service that sends mail from an old address to a new one

examples.en: I arranged mail forwarding because my internship letters might still go to the old flat.
examples.zh: 实习信件可能还会寄到旧公寓，所以我办了「邮件转寄」。

examples.en: Set up mail forwarding before moving if you are expecting any important letters.
examples.zh: 如果还在等重要信件，搬家前办好「邮件转寄」。

words.enDefinition: a form used to report a new postal or residential address

examples.en: The university sent me a change of address form when I left student housing.
examples.zh: 我搬出学生公寓时，学校发给我一份「地址变更表」。

examples.en: I filled out a change of address form before leaving for the summer.
examples.zh: 暑假离校前，我填好了一份「地址变更表」。

collocations: fill in a change of address form
submit a change of address form
download the change of address form

words.enDefinition: an address used for a short period before settling elsewhere

examples.en: I gave the bursar my temporary address until I knew where I would live.
examples.zh: 住处还没定下来，我先把「临时地址」留给了财务办公室。

examples.en: Use a temporary address if your new flat will not be ready by Monday.
examples.zh: 如果新公寓到周一还不能入住，就先留个「临时地址」。

words.enDefinition: a site where customers rent private spaces to store belongings

examples.en: The self-storage facility offered a student rate if we booked before June.
examples.zh: 只要在六月前预约，「自助仓储中心」就给我们学生价。

examples.en: I chose a self-storage facility within walking distance of the new flat.
examples.zh: 我选了从新公寓步行可到的「自助仓储中心」。

collocations: book space at a self-storage facility

words.enDefinition: storage rented for a limited period rather than permanently

examples.en: We needed short-term storage because our leases did not overlap that summer.
examples.zh: 那年暑假，新旧租期接不上，我们需要「短期寄存」。

examples.en: My housemate suggested short-term storage instead of taking everything home on the train.
examples.zh: 室友建议办「短期寄存」，免得坐火车时把所有东西带回家。

words.enDefinition: an individually secured compartment rented for keeping belongings

examples.en: My small storage locker had enough room for two suitcases and a guitar.
examples.zh: 我的小「储物柜」能放下两个行李箱和一把吉他。

examples.en: We left the spare bedding in a storage locker near the station.
examples.zh: 我们把备用床品放在车站附近的一个「储物柜」里。

words.enDefinition: storage in a space with regulated temperature and often humidity

examples.en: We chose climate-controlled storage because our boxes contained books and some musical instruments.
examples.zh: 箱子里有书和一些乐器，所以我们选了「控温储存」。

examples.en: The extra cost of climate-controlled storage was worth it for storing my guitar.
examples.zh: 为寄存吉他多花点钱办「控温储存」，我觉得值。

words.enDefinition: a strong box made for packing items during a move

examples.en: One moving box was enough for all the clothes in my narrow wardrobe.
examples.zh: 我那个窄衣柜里的全部衣服，一个「搬家纸箱」就装下了。

examples.en: The corner shop gave us a moving box for the rest of our books.
examples.zh: 街角商店给了我们一个「搬家纸箱」，用来装剩下的书。

words.enDefinition: a tall moving box with a bar for hanging clothes

examples.en: My suit went into a wardrobe box so it wouldn't crease on the journey.
examples.zh: 我把西装放进「挂衣搬家箱」，免得路上起皱。

examples.en: The movers supplied a wardrobe box for the coats we could not fold.
examples.zh: 那些大衣没法叠起来，搬家工人给我们提供了一个「挂衣搬家箱」。

collocations: hang clothes in a wardrobe box

words.enDefinition: strong adhesive tape used to seal shipping or moving boxes

examples.en: The bottom of the box split because I had used too little packing tape.
examples.zh: 我用的「封箱胶带」太少，箱子底一下就裂了。

examples.en: Can you bring some packing tape when you come to help us on Friday?
examples.zh: 周五来帮忙的时候，能带点「封箱胶带」吗？

words.enDefinition: paper used to wrap and protect items before transport

examples.en: We used packing paper to keep the glasses from knocking against one another.
examples.zh: 我们用「打包用纸」把玻璃杯隔开，免得磕碰。

examples.en: Save the packing paper when you unpack because we can use it again later.
examples.zh: 拆箱时把「打包用纸」留下来，以后还能用。

words.enDefinition: small pieces placed in packages to cushion the contents

examples.en: The shop packed the lamp in packing peanuts so it would not move around.
examples.zh: 店家用「泡沫填充粒」把台灯填实了，免得它在箱里晃动。

examples.en: I sorted the packing peanuts into a separate bag after setting up the lamp.
examples.zh: 装好台灯后，我把「泡沫填充粒」另装进一个袋子。

collocations: fill a box with packing peanuts

words.enDefinition: plastic sheeting with small air pockets for protecting fragile objects

examples.en: Wrap the picture frame in bubble wrap before putting it next to the books.
examples.zh: 相框先用「气泡包装膜」包好，再放在书旁边。

examples.en: I saved the bubble wrap from a parcel for the night we packed up.
examples.zh: 包裹里的「气泡包装膜」我留了下来，准备搬家打包那晚用。

words.enDefinition: a thick cover that protects furniture during a move

examples.en: We borrowed a furniture blanket to stop the dresser getting scratched in the van.
examples.zh: 我们借了块「家具防护毯」，免得五斗柜在车里刮花。

examples.en: The movers wrapped the table in a furniture blanket before taking it downstairs.
examples.zh: 搬家工人先用「家具防护毯」包上桌子，再往楼下搬。

words.enDefinition: stretchy plastic film used to hold items together

examples.en: The movers used stretch wrap to keep the dresser drawers from sliding open.
examples.zh: 搬家工人用「拉伸缠绕膜」固定五斗柜的抽屉，免得它们滑开。

examples.en: I removed the stretch wrap from the chair legs after the delivery arrived.
examples.zh: 送货到了以后，我拆掉了椅腿上的「拉伸缠绕膜」。

words.enDefinition: a large protective bag used to cover a mattress during transport

examples.en: We put the mattress in a mattress bag before carrying it through the rain.
examples.zh: 我们把床垫套进「床垫防护袋」，才冒雨把它搬出去。

examples.en: The mattress bag tore when we tried to squeeze it through the narrow doorway.
examples.zh: 我们试着把床垫挤过窄门时，「床垫防护袋」撕裂了。

collocations: put a mattress in a mattress bag

words.enDefinition: a bag that compresses soft items when air is removed

examples.en: I used a vacuum storage bag to fit my spare bedding into one case.
examples.zh: 我用了个「真空收纳袋」，把备用床品都装进一个箱子。

examples.en: The vacuum storage bag freed up enough room for my winter coat as well.
examples.zh: 用了「真空收纳袋」省出的空间，还能再放一件冬季外套。

collocations: pack in a vacuum storage bag

words.enDefinition: a partition placed inside a box to separate individual objects

examples.en: A box divider kept my mugs in place during the ride across town.
examples.zh: 「箱内隔板」固定了马克杯，才没在穿城路上晃动。

examples.en: I slipped a box divider between the glasses before sealing the carton up.
examples.zh: 封箱前，我在玻璃杯之间加了一块「箱内隔板」。

words.enDefinition: a protective piece placed over the corner of an object

examples.en: Put a corner protector on the frame before loading it into the van.
examples.zh: 把相框装车前，先在框角套一个「边角护垫」。

examples.en: One corner protector fell off the mirror as we took it down the stairs.
examples.zh: 往楼下搬镜子时，有个「边角护垫」掉了下来。

words.enDefinition: a two-wheeled frame for moving heavy or stacked items

examples.en: The caretaker lent us a hand truck to move the boxes from reception.
examples.zh: 管理员借给我们一辆「两轮搬运车」，好把箱子从前台搬走。

examples.en: You can take two boxes at once if you use the hand truck.
examples.zh: 用「两轮搬运车」的话，一次能搬两箱。

collocations: move boxes with a hand truck

words.enDefinition: a low wheeled platform used to move heavy items

examples.en: A moving dolly helped us slide the dresser along the hall without lifting it.
examples.zh: 借助「平板搬运车」，我们不用抬，就把五斗柜推过了走廊。

examples.en: The movers brought a moving dolly for the heavier boxes of books and records.
examples.zh: 搬家工人带了辆「平板搬运车」，用来运比较重的几箱书和唱片。

words.enDefinition: a strap used by people to lift and carry heavy objects

examples.en: One moving strap slipped while we were lifting the desk onto the stairs.
examples.zh: 我们把书桌抬上楼梯时，有一根「搬运背带」滑掉了。

examples.en: The movers had a spare moving strap for the cabinet in the study.
examples.zh: 搬家工人有条备用的「搬运背带」，正好用来搬书房的柜子。

words.enDefinition: a strap used to stop transported items from moving

examples.en: We used a cargo strap to keep the bookcase still inside the van.
examples.zh: 我们用一条「货物固定带」把书架固定在货车里。

examples.en: The driver checked every cargo strap before pulling away from our old flat.
examples.zh: 司机把车开离旧公寓前，检查了每条「货物固定带」。

words.enDefinition: a label warning that an item can break easily

examples.en: I put a fragile label on the box with all the coffee mugs.
examples.zh: 我在装马克杯的箱子上贴了张「易碎品标签」。

examples.en: The movers spotted the fragile label and set that carton down first.
examples.zh: 搬家工人看到「易碎品标签」，先把那只纸箱放了下来。

words.enDefinition: a label showing which room an item should go to

examples.en: We added a room label to each box to make unloading easier later.
examples.zh: 我们给每个箱子贴了「房间标识贴」，方便待会儿卸货。

examples.en: The room label said kitchen, but the box was full of my notes.
examples.zh: 「房间标识贴」上写着厨房，可箱子里全是我的笔记。

words.enDefinition: to gather and pack the belongings in a room

examples.en: I still need to pack up the room before my parents collect me.
examples.zh: 爸妈来接我之前，我还得「把房间里的东西打包」。

examples.en: We took the photos down first before we started to pack up the room.
examples.zh: 开始「把房间里的东西打包」之前，我们先把照片取了下来。

collocations: help to pack up the room
start to pack up the room
need to pack up the room

words.enDefinition: to pack a bag of necessities to keep within reach

examples.en: I decided to pack an essentials bag so I could find my charger later.
examples.zh: 我决定「打包一袋随身必需品」，之后找充电器方便些。

examples.en: Remember to pack an essentials bag for your first night in the new flat.
examples.zh: 为在新公寓的第一晚，记得「打包一袋随身必需品」。

collocations: plan to pack an essentials bag
remember to pack an essentials bag

words.enDefinition: to close boxes securely so their contents cannot fall out

examples.en: We waited to seal the boxes until everyone had found their phone chargers.
examples.zh: 等大家都找到了自己的充电器，我们才「把箱子封好」。

examples.en: Could you seal the boxes while I take the last few bags downstairs?
examples.zh: 我把最后几袋东西拿下楼时，你能「封好箱子」吗？

words.enDefinition: to take packed boxes to a lower floor by carrying them

examples.en: Our friends came early to help us carry the boxes downstairs before lunch.
examples.zh: 朋友们早早就到了，帮我们赶在午饭前「把箱子搬下楼」。

examples.en: I can carry the boxes downstairs if you hold the front door open.
examples.zh: 你帮我撑着大门的话，我可以「把箱子搬下楼」。

collocations: help to carry the boxes downstairs
start to carry the boxes downstairs

words.enDefinition: to put the items being moved inside a van

examples.en: The driver let us load the van while he checked the new address.
examples.zh: 司机去核对新地址，让我们先「把东西装上货车」。

examples.en: We had to load the van before the student housing office closed for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们得在住宿办公室午休关门前「把东西装上货车」。

words.enDefinition: to take the things being moved out of a van

examples.en: We stopped for water before we started to unload the van at the flat.
examples.zh: 到了公寓，我们先停下来喝了点水，再「从货车上卸货」。

examples.en: My neighbour offered to help unload the van when she saw us outside.
examples.zh: 邻居看到我们在外面，就主动帮我们「从货车上卸货」。

words.enDefinition: to open moving boxes and take their contents out

examples.en: We didn't unpack the boxes right away because the room still needed cleaning.
examples.zh: 房间还没打扫，我们就没马上「拆箱整理」。

examples.en: I left the desk clear so I could unpack the boxes after class.
examples.zh: 我把桌面空了出来，准备下课后「拆箱整理」。

collocations: unpack the boxes one by one

words.enDefinition: a place where people can leave items for donation

examples.en: The donation drop-off point on campus filled up quickly during the last week.
examples.zh: 最后一周，学校的「捐赠物品投放点」很快就满了。

examples.en: I checked which items the donation drop-off point would accept before carrying everything over.
examples.zh: 把东西全搬过去之前，我先确认了「捐赠物品投放点」收哪些东西。

words.enDefinition: a service that collects large items discarded by households

examples.en: We booked a bulky waste collection for the mattress we could not take.
examples.zh: 那张床垫带不走，我们预约了「大件垃圾清运」。

examples.en: The council's bulky waste collection service would not take any old computer batteries.
examples.zh: 市政的「大件垃圾清运」服务不收旧电脑电池。

words.enDefinition: a board for announcements aimed at building residents

examples.en: I checked the building noticeboard for the dates when the bins would be moved.
examples.zh: 我去看了「楼内公告栏」，确认垃圾桶哪几天会挪位置。

examples.en: Someone put a note about a lost set of keys on the building noticeboard.
examples.zh: 有人在「楼内公告栏」上贴了张丢钥匙的启事。

words.enDefinition: a gathering where residents discuss issues affecting their building or area

examples.en: I went to the residents' meeting to ask about lighting by the back entrance.
examples.zh: 我去参加了「住户会议」，想问问后门附近的照明问题。

examples.en: The next residents' meeting will be held in the lobby on Thursday evening.
examples.zh: 下一次「住户会议」将在周四晚上于大堂举行。

words.enDefinition: a group representing the interests of people who live in an area

examples.en: The residents' association helped us find out who managed the shared garden downstairs.
examples.zh: 「住户协会」帮我们打听到楼下共用花园归谁管。

examples.en: Our residents' association sends a monthly email with updates about the building and street.
examples.zh: 我们的「住户协会」每月发邮件，告诉大家楼里和街上的新消息。

words.enDefinition: an entrance shared by residents of more than one home

examples.en: Please keep the communal entrance clear so other residents can get through the door.
examples.zh: 请别在「共用入口」堆东西，方便其他住户进出。

examples.en: The delivery driver left our parcels at the communal entrance instead of ringing the bell.
examples.zh: 快递员没按门铃，把包裹放在了「共用入口」。

words.enDefinition: a stairwell used by residents of several homes

examples.en: We kept our shoes inside so the shared stairwell would stay clear for everyone.
examples.zh: 鞋子我们放在家里，免得挡了大家走「共用楼梯间」。

examples.en: The caretaker said bikes could not be left unattended in our shared stairwell.
examples.zh: 管理员说，自行车不能随便停在「共用楼梯间」。

words.enDefinition: a buzzer visitors use to alert someone inside a building

examples.en: The entry buzzer rang just as I was putting my headphones on for class.
examples.zh: 我刚戴上耳机准备上课，「门禁呼叫铃」就响了。

examples.en: Tell the driver which entry buzzer to press when she gets to the building.
examples.zh: 告诉司机，到楼下该按哪个「门禁呼叫铃」。

words.enDefinition: a secure compartment where delivery companies can leave packages

examples.en: The driver left my textbooks in the parcel locker near the bike racks.
examples.zh: 快递员把我的教材放进了自行车架旁的「包裹自提柜」。

examples.en: I collected the parcel locker code from my email after my lecture ended.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在邮箱里找到了「包裹自提柜」的取件码。

words.enDefinition: to keep a delivered package until I can collect it

examples.en: Could you hold a package for me if it arrives before I get home?
examples.zh: 包裹要是在我到家前送到，你能「帮我暂收包裹」吗？

examples.en: I asked reception if they could hold a package for me until after class.
examples.zh: 我问前台能不能「帮我暂收包裹」，等我下课再取。

collocations: offer to hold a package for me
ask someone to hold a package for me
agree to hold a package for me

words.enDefinition: to pick up a package waiting at a named location

examples.en: You can collect a parcel from reception during its opening hours on weekdays.
examples.zh: 工作日开放时间内，你可以去前台「领取包裹」。

examples.en: I stopped to collect a parcel on my way back from the library.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆回来的路上顺便去「领取包裹」。

words.enDefinition: a package delivered to the wrong person or place

examples.en: I returned a misdelivered parcel to the neighbour whose flat number was on it.
examples.zh: 有个「送错地址的包裹」，我按上面的房号还给了邻居。

examples.en: The label on the misdelivered parcel showed an address in the next block.
examples.zh: 那个「送错地址的包裹」上写的是隔壁街区的地址。

words.enDefinition: an open yard used by residents of several homes

examples.en: Our building has a shared courtyard where flatmates sometimes eat lunch on sunny days.
examples.zh: 我们楼有个「共用庭院」，天晴时室友有时在那里吃午饭。

examples.en: The residents asked everyone to clear the shared courtyard after the summer barbecue.
examples.zh: 夏日烧烤结束后，住户请大家一起收拾「共用庭院」。

words.enDefinition: a garden shared by residents of a building or neighbourhood

examples.en: Two of my neighbours grow tomatoes in the communal garden behind our building.
examples.zh: 我有两个邻居在楼后的「共用花园」里种西红柿。

examples.en: We asked if students could volunteer to help look after the communal garden.
examples.zh: 我们问了学生能不能当志愿者，一起打理「共用花园」。

words.enDefinition: a small growing area assigned to someone in a shared garden

examples.en: I put my name down for a community garden plot at the open day.
examples.zh: 开放日那天，我报名申请了一块「社区花园种植地块」。

examples.en: My neighbour showed me the community garden plot where she grows fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 邻居给我看了她种香草的「社区花园种植地块」。

collocations: apply for a community garden plot

words.enDefinition: an enclosed area where a building keeps its rubbish bins

examples.en: The caretaker unlocked the bin store so we could put our recycling away.
examples.zh: 管理员打开了「垃圾桶存放处」，让我们把可回收物放进去。

examples.en: The map near the lift shows how to find the bin store downstairs.
examples.zh: 电梯旁的示意图标出了楼下「垃圾桶存放处」怎么走。

words.enDefinition: the day when household bins are emptied by a collection service

examples.en: Our bin collection day changed after the bank holiday, according to the notice.
examples.zh: 通知说公共假日过后，我们的「垃圾收运日」改了。

examples.en: I checked the bin collection day before putting the heavy recycling bin outside.
examples.zh: 把沉甸甸的回收桶推出去之前，我先查了「垃圾收运日」。

words.enDefinition: a service that collects recyclables left by the road

examples.en: The leaflet explained which plastics our town accepts for curbside recycling each week.
examples.zh: 宣传单讲了镇上的「路边回收」每周收哪些塑料。

examples.en: We used curbside recycling for the empty boxes after unpacking over the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末拆完箱后，我们把空箱子交给了「路边回收」。

words.enDefinition: a schedule showing when recyclable materials will be picked up

examples.en: I stuck the recycling collection calendar on the fridge beside our shopping list.
examples.zh: 我把「回收物收运日历」贴在冰箱上，挨着购物清单。

examples.en: The recycling collection calendar helped my new flatmate work out when to put boxes outside.
examples.zh: 新室友看了「回收物收运日历」，知道该什么时候把纸箱拿出去。

collocations: refer to the recycling collection calendar

words.enDefinition: to put rubbish bins outside for collection

examples.en: Could you take the bins out before you leave for your evening class?
examples.zh: 你出门上晚课之前，能「把垃圾桶推出去」吗？

examples.en: We forgot to take the bins out on Tuesday because of the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期弄混了日子，我们周二忘了「把垃圾桶推出去」。

collocations: remember to take the bins out
take the bins out on Tuesday
offer to take the bins out

words.enDefinition: to bring waste bins back after they have been emptied

examples.en: I'll return the bins once the collection truck has gone past our block.
examples.zh: 收垃圾的车开过我们街区后，我会「把垃圾桶推回来」。

examples.en: Could you return the bins before the evening so the pavement stays clear?
examples.zh: 你能在傍晚前「把垃圾桶推回来」吗？这样人行道就不会被挡住。

words.enDefinition: a report about noise that is disturbing other people

examples.en: The housing office received a noise complaint after a party in the flat above.
examples.zh: 楼上公寓开过一次派对后，住宿办公室收到了一起「噪音投诉」。

examples.en: I spoke to my neighbour before calling reception to make a noise complaint.
examples.zh: 打电话去前台作「噪音投诉」之前，我先和邻居聊了聊。

words.enDefinition: noise that disrupts other people's ability to rest or concentrate

examples.en: The caretaker asked us when the noise disturbance started and how long it lasted.
examples.zh: 管理员问我们「噪音扰民」是从什么时候开始的，持续了多久。

examples.en: We reported a noise disturbance because the music carried through the wall every night.
examples.zh: 音乐每晚都穿墙传过来，我们就报告了「噪音扰民」。

words.enDefinition: a request to make less noise

examples.en: Could you keep it down until my online interview finishes in ten minutes?
examples.zh: 能「声音小点」吗？我的线上面试还有十分钟结束。

examples.en: We asked them to keep it down because several students had exams the next day.
examples.zh: 好几个同学第二天考试，我们请他们「声音小点」。

collocations: ask someone to keep it down

words.enDefinition: noise travels easily from one place to another

examples.en: In this building, sound carries through the walls even when people speak quietly.
examples.zh: 这栋楼里「声音很容易传开」，即使隔壁说话不大声也能听见。

examples.en: We didn't realise sound carries so far along the corridor after ten at night.
examples.zh: 我们没想到晚上十点过后，「声音很容易传到」走廊很远的位置。

words.enDefinition: a person living in the home above yours

examples.en: Our upstairs neighbour offered to accept parcels while I was away for the holidays.
examples.zh: 我假期外出时，「楼上邻居」主动提出帮忙收包裹。

examples.en: I introduced myself to the upstairs neighbour while carrying boxes into the new flat.
examples.zh: 把箱子搬进新公寓时，我跟「楼上邻居」打了招呼。

words.enDefinition: someone living in the property immediately beside yours

examples.en: My next-door neighbour lent me a screwdriver on the afternoon I moved in.
examples.zh: 我搬进去的当天下午，「隔壁邻居」借给我一把螺丝刀。

examples.en: I gave my next-door neighbour a heads-up about the moving van on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我提前跟「隔壁邻居」打了声招呼，说周六有搬家货车来。

collocations: introduce yourself to a next-door neighbour

words.enDefinition: to knock on a neighbouring home's door

examples.en: I went to knock next door after hearing water running down the wall.
examples.zh: 听到水沿墙往下流，我就去「敲了隔壁的门」。

examples.en: Could you knock next door and ask whether our parcel was delivered there?
examples.zh: 你能「敲一下隔壁的门」，问问包裹是不是送过去了吗？

words.expression: write a note to the neighbours
words.lemma: write a note to the neighbours
words.enDefinition: to leave neighbours a written message about something affecting them
acceptedEnVariants: write a note to the neighbours

examples.en: We decided to write a note to the neighbours before moving furniture on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们决定周六搬家具之前，先「给邻居留张纸条」。

examples.en: I'll write a note to the neighbours in case nobody is home when we leave.
examples.zh: 走的时候要是隔壁没人，我就「给邻居留张纸条」。

collocations: plan to write a note to the neighbours
offer to write a note to the neighbours
remember to write a note to the neighbours

words.enDefinition: a party held to celebrate moving into a new home

examples.en: My new flatmates threw a housewarming party and invited the neighbours from upstairs.
examples.zh: 新室友办了场「乔迁聚会」，也邀请了楼上的邻居。

examples.en: We kept the housewarming party small because several people had morning classes the next day.
examples.zh: 好几个人隔天早上有课，所以我们的「乔迁聚会」只请了少数人。

collocations: invite someone to a housewarming party

words.enDefinition: a gift for someone who has just moved into a home

examples.en: My neighbour brought a plant as a housewarming gift on the day I moved.
examples.zh: 我搬家那天，邻居送了一盆植物作「乔迁礼物」。

examples.en: We chose a second-hand cookbook as a housewarming gift for our former flatmate.
examples.zh: 我们选了本二手食谱，送给以前的室友当「乔迁礼物」。

words.enDefinition: parking spaces set aside for people visiting a property

examples.en: My parents used visitor parking while they helped carry my clothes into the flat.
examples.zh: 爸妈帮我把衣服搬进公寓时，车停在「访客停车区」。

examples.en: There is visitor parking behind our building, but it fills up after five.
examples.zh: 楼后有「访客停车区」，不过五点之后就会停满。

words.enDefinition: a permit that lets a visitor park at a property

examples.en: Reception gave my dad a guest parking pass while he helped me move.
examples.zh: 爸爸帮我搬家时，前台给了他一张「访客停车证」。

examples.en: I returned the guest parking pass after my friend drove back to campus.
examples.zh: 朋友开车回学校后，我归还了「访客停车证」。

words.enDefinition: permission for a resident to park in a designated area

examples.en: We applied for a resident parking permit as soon as our tenancy began.
examples.zh: 租期一开始，我们就申请了「住户停车许可证」。

examples.en: I had to update my resident parking permit after borrowing my mother's car.
examples.zh: 我借来妈妈的车之后，得更新自己的「住户停车许可证」。

collocations: apply for a resident parking permit

words.enDefinition: a particular parking spot assigned to a person or purpose

examples.en: Our designated parking space was too far from the entrance for unloading the van.
examples.zh: 我们的「指定停车位」离入口太远，不方便从货车上卸东西。

examples.en: Someone parked in my designated parking space while I was away for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我周末外出时，有人把车停在了我的「指定停车位」上。

collocations: park in a designated parking space

words.enDefinition: a driveway that more than one property uses for access

examples.en: I let the neighbours know before leaving the van on the shared driveway.
examples.zh: 把货车停在「共用车道」上之前，我先和邻居打了声招呼。

examples.en: Please leave enough room on the shared driveway for both cars to get through.
examples.zh: 请在「共用车道」上留出足够空间，让两辆车都能通过。

words.enDefinition: the day when a council cleans a street with dedicated equipment

examples.en: I moved my car before class because Monday was our street cleaning day.
examples.zh: 周一是本街的「街道清扫日」，我在上课前挪了车。

examples.en: The sign shows street cleaning day for each side of the road near campus.
examples.zh: 标牌标明了学校附近这条路两侧各自的「街道清扫日」。

collocations: move the car on street cleaning day

words.enDefinition: the activity of collecting rubbish from outdoor public spaces

examples.en: I joined the neighbours for litter picking along our street on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 周六上午我和邻居们一起沿街「捡拾散落垃圾」。

examples.en: The student union supplied gloves for litter picking near the local bus stops.
examples.zh: 学生会为公交站附近的「捡拾散落垃圾」活动提供了手套。

words.enDefinition: an online conversation shared by people living in the same area

examples.en: Someone in the neighbourhood group chat asked who owned the bike by our gate.
examples.zh: 「邻里群聊」里有人问，我们门口那辆自行车是谁的。

examples.en: I joined the neighbourhood group chat a few days after moving into the flat.
examples.zh: 搬进公寓几天后，我加入了「邻里群聊」。

collocations: post in the neighbourhood group chat
set up a neighbourhood group chat

words.enDefinition: to tell nearby residents your name when you first meet

examples.en: It's easier to introduce yourself to the neighbours when you see them outside.
examples.zh: 在室外碰到邻居时，比较容易开口「向邻居自我介绍」。

examples.en: My flatmate told me, “Introduce yourself to the neighbours before asking about bin day.”
examples.zh: 室友说，在问哪天收垃圾之前，先「向邻居自我介绍」。

collocations: remember to introduce yourself to the neighbours
go and introduce yourself to the neighbours
try to introduce yourself to the neighbours

words.enDefinition: to get to know the people living near you

examples.en: I finally got to meet the neighbours when we all cleared the courtyard.
examples.zh: 大家一起收拾庭院时，我终于有机会「认识邻居」。

examples.en: The building manager organised a barbecue so new students could meet the neighbours.
examples.zh: 管理员组织了场烧烤，让新来的同学有机会「认识邻居」。

collocations: a chance to meet the neighbours

words.enDefinition: to give each other your telephone numbers

examples.en: My new flatmate suggested we exchange numbers in case either of us got locked out.
examples.zh: 新室友建议「互留电话号码」，以防谁被锁在门外。

examples.en: We can exchange numbers if you want updates about the delivery time tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果你想知道明天送货时间的变化，我们可以「互留电话号码」。

words.enDefinition: to share cleaning duties by doing them one after another

examples.en: The four of us take turns cleaning the shared kitchen after Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 我们四个人每周日晚饭后「轮流打扫」共用厨房。

examples.en: Could we take turns cleaning instead of asking the same person every week?
examples.zh: 我们能不能「轮流打扫」，别每周都让同一个人来？

words.enDefinition: a schedule assigning cleaning duties to different people in turn

examples.en: Our cleaning rota is on the fridge, next to the grocery list.
examples.zh: 我们的「轮值清洁表」贴在冰箱上，挨着买菜清单。

examples.en: We updated the cleaning rota because my evening classes now finish on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我的晚课现在最后一节在周四，所以我们更新了「轮值清洁表」。

words.enDefinition: to trade assigned cleaning days with another person

examples.en: Could we swap cleaning days because I have an exam early on Tuesday?
examples.zh: 我周二一早有考试，我们能不能「交换清洁值日」？

examples.en: My roommate offered to swap cleaning days after I covered her shift last week.
examples.zh: 上周我替室友值日后，她主动提出「交换清洁值日」。

words.expression: leave it as you found it
words.lemma: leave it as you found it
words.enDefinition: a request to return a place or object to its prior condition
acceptedEnVariants: leave it as you found it

examples.en: If you use our shared study room, please leave it as you found it.
examples.zh: 如果使用我们的共用自习室，请「用完恢复原样」。

examples.en: The note says to leave it as you found it after using the laundry room.
examples.zh: 纸条上写着，洗衣房「用完要恢复原样」。

collocations: please leave it as you found it
remember to leave it as you found it
try to leave it as you found it

words.enDefinition: a meeting of housemates to discuss how their shared home is run

examples.en: We called a house meeting to decide how to share fridge space fairly.
examples.zh: 我们开了个「合租室友会议」，商量怎样公平分配冰箱空间。

examples.en: The new tenant introduced herself at a house meeting the evening she arrived.
examples.zh: 新室友到的那晚，在「合租室友会议」上作了自我介绍。

collocations: bring something up at a house meeting

words.enDefinition: an agreement between people sharing a home about daily responsibilities

examples.en: We wrote a roommate agreement that covered overnight guests, dishes and weekday quiet hours.
examples.zh: 我们写了份「室友公约」，约定留宿访客、洗碗和工作日安静时段。

examples.en: The accommodation office sent us a sample roommate agreement before we moved into residence.
examples.zh: 搬进宿舍前，住宿办公室给我们发了一份「室友公约」范本。

words.enDefinition: a shelf that several people use to keep common items

examples.en: We keep tea and coffee on the shared shelf near the kitchen door.
examples.zh: 茶和咖啡放在厨房门附近的「共用置物架」上。

examples.en: Please leave a little space on the shared shelf for the new flatmate.
examples.zh: 请在「共用置物架」上留一点位置给新室友。

collocations: put something on the shared shelf

words.enDefinition: to mark food with your name so people know who owns it

examples.en: Please label your food before putting it in the fridge on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 食物放进一楼冰箱之前，请先「给自己的食物贴标签」。

examples.en: You don't need to label your food if it's for everyone in the house.
examples.zh: 如果是给全屋人一起吃的，就不用「给自己的食物贴标签」。

collocations: label your food with your name

words.enDefinition: to replenish shared supplies after using some of them

examples.en: Please replace what you use so we always have tea and washing-up liquid.
examples.zh: 请「用多少补多少」，这样我们就总有茶和洗洁精可用。

examples.en: Our note says to replace what you use before the kitchen supplies run out.
examples.zh: 我们留了张纸条，请大家在厨房用品用完前「用多少补多少」。

collocations: remember to replace what you use
offer to replace what you use

words.enDefinition: money put together to buy groceries that housemates share

examples.en: We started a shared grocery fund for milk, bread and other kitchen basics.
examples.zh: 我们凑了笔「合租共用食品费」，用来买牛奶、面包等日常食品。

examples.en: Each flatmate pays a little into the shared grocery fund at the start of term.
examples.zh: 开学时每个室友都会往「合租共用食品费」里交一点。

collocations: set up a shared grocery fund
pay into the shared grocery fund

words.enDefinition: to visit someone without telling them in advance

examples.en: Our neighbours asked us to text first rather than drop by unannounced after dinner.
examples.zh: 邻居请我们晚饭后拜访前先发短信，别「不打招呼就登门」。

examples.en: I don't want to drop by unannounced while she's studying for her final exams.
examples.zh: 她在复习期末考试，我不想「不打招呼就登门」。

collocations: decide not to drop by unannounced
ask before you drop by unannounced

words.enDefinition: to tell neighbours in advance about something that might affect them

examples.en: We should give the neighbours a heads-up before the moving van blocks the driveway.
examples.zh: 在搬家货车堵住车道前，我们应该「提前知会邻居」。

examples.en: I'll give the neighbours a heads-up if we decide to have friends over Friday.
examples.zh: 我们要是决定周五请朋友过来，我就「提前知会邻居」。

collocations: remember to give the neighbours a heads-up
offer to give the neighbours a heads-up
call to give the neighbours a heads-up

words.enDefinition: to avoid leaving things that might block people in the hallway

examples.en: The warden asked us to keep the hallway clear while the kitchen was being painted.
examples.zh: 厨房刷漆时，宿舍管理员请我们「保持走廊畅通」。

examples.en: Please keep the hallway clear so everyone can get past with their moving boxes.
examples.zh: 请「保持走廊畅通」，方便大家搬着箱子通过。

collocations: try to keep the hallway clear
remember to keep the hallway clear
help to keep the hallway clear

words.enDefinition: a reservation made to use a shared recreation room

examples.en: I made a common room booking for our flat's first movie night in March.
examples.zh: 我办了「公共活动室预约」，准备三月第一次和室友一起看电影。

examples.en: Our common room booking ends at nine, so we need to start early.
examples.zh: 我们的「公共活动室预约」到九点结束，所以得早点开始。
